description: Allows the addition, modification and deletion of sessions in a Consul cluster. These sessions can then be used in conjunction with key value pairs to implement distributed locks. In depth documentation for working with sessions can be found at http://www.consul.io/docs/internals/sessions.html.

parameters.name: behavior
parameters.description: The optional behavior that can be attached to the session when it is created. This controls the behavior when a session is invalidated. Choices: "delete" "release" ← (default)

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: checks
parameters.description: Checks that are used to verify the session health. If all the checks fail, the session is invalidated and any locks associated with the session are released and can be acquired once the associated lock delay has expired.

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: The name of the datacenter in which the session exists or should be created.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: The optional lock delay that can be attached to the session when it is created. Locks for invalidated sessions ar blocked from being acquired until this delay has expired. Durations are in seconds. Default: 15

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the session, required when state is either info or remove.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name that should be associated with the session. Required when state=node is used.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The name of the node that with which the session is associated. By default this is the name of the agent.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the session should be present, in other words it should be created if it does not exist, or absent, removed if present. If created, the id for the session is returned in the output. If absent, id is required to remove the session. Info for a single session, all the sessions for a node or all available sessions can be retrieved by specifying info, node or list for the state; for node or info, the node name or session id is required as parameter. Choices: "absent" "info" "list" "node" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token to use for authorization.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Specifies the duration of a session in seconds (between 10 and 86400).

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Register basic session with Consul
  community.general.consul_session:
    name: session1

- name: Register a session with an existing check
  community.general.consul_session:
    name: session_with_check
    checks:
      - existing_check_name

- name: Register a session with lock_delay
  community.general.consul_session:
    name: session_with_delay
    delay: 20s

- name: Retrieve info about session by id
  community.general.consul_session:
    id: session_id
    state: info

- name: Retrieve active sessions
  community.general.consul_session:
    state: list

- name: Register session with a ttl
  community.general.consul_session:
    name: session-with-ttl
    ttl: 600 # sec
